input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality. The architecture follows a layered approach separating concerns across presentation, business logic, and data access.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Candidate, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
As a Admin, I want to receive feedback on my actions, so that I know the system processed my request.
